# Trinity College Dublin

> Trinity College Dublin is Ireland's leading research university, offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs across humanities, sciences, and health professions with a strategic focus on innovation, sustainability, and student wellbeing.

Trinity College Dublin (TCD) is one of Europe's oldest universities, located in Dublin, Ireland. The institution emphasizes research excellence, innovation commercialization, and comprehensive student support services across its academic faculties and schools.

## Key Topics

- Undergraduate Programs
- Postgraduate Programs
- Research Excellence
- Innovation and Entrepreneurship
- Sustainability
- Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences
- Faculty of Health Sciences
- Mental Health and Wellbeing
- Equality and Diversity
- CPD and Micro-credentials
- Strategic Plan 2025-2030
- Campus Events
- Student Support Services
- Machine Learning Research
- Net Zero 2040
